flipToBack.prose: Flip if four active, spottable ISB agents are anywhere on table, ownership unrestricted, OR the owner controls at least two Rebel Base locations, each with an owned active non-undercover ISB agent. Lieutenant Blount occupying Coruscant externally prevents the flip.

flipToFront.timing: The objective's singleton table-change trigger flips back when zero active ISB agents are spottable. Lieutenant Blount also forcibly flips the back when he occupies Coruscant.
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if no active, spottable ISB agent remains anywhere on table, or through Lieutenant Blount's separate forced-front trigger while he occupies Coruscant.

children.req: Lieutenant Blount occupies any Coruscant location

requirementSemantics: Front route A is a pure active-card count anywhere on table. It is ownership-unrestricted and has no location gate.
Front route B is CONTROL-WITH at two Rebel Base locations. Each location must be controlled by the objective owner and have that owner's active non-undercover ISB agent there.
SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE includes excluded cards but does not make undercover, captive, or otherwise inactive cards spottable.
Back flip is pure active-agent absence. Losing every spottable agent flips the objective front.
Lieutenant Blount is external to the native objective OR expression. While he occupies Coruscant, the front cannot flip and the back is forcibly flipped front.
Back payoff requires a non-undercover ISB agent present at a battleground site. It does not require control and does not multiply per agent.

setupAndPullRoutes: Setup: deploy any Coruscant location from Reserve Deck. Card7_299.java:45-55.
Back, once during each owner draw phase: retrieve one ISB agent from Lost Pile. Card7_299_BACK.java:47-62.
The front does not tutor characters. Qualifying characters deploy normally but ignore their own location deployment restrictions while the objective is active.
otherObligations: Both faces continuously grant ISB agent and spy keywords to the owner's lore-matching characters and let them ignore their own location restrictions.
Back: own Force drain +1 at a battleground site where an owned non-undercover ISB agent is present.
Back: opponent Force drains -1 at that site and related locations.
Strategic: preserve one active ISB agent after flipping and remove or neutralize a Coruscant-occupying Lieutenant Blount.
contradictionsResolved: Route A is anywhere on table, not Coruscant-only.
Route B includes Hoth and Yavin 4 systems and their related sites, not battleground sites only.
Route A is ownership-unrestricted; route B's controlsWith helper requires the owner's non-undercover agent at each owned-controlled location.
Undercover agents are invisible to the flip and hold despite INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.
Lieutenant Blount is an external prevent-and-forced-front effect, not another alternative inside the native objective's OR.
The back drain payoff requires presence, not control, and does not multiply for multiple agents.
